name: Audit
description: Mark an enemy: exposes its weakness and stat sheet. Marked enemies take more damage.

name: Enforce
description: Heavy kinetic hit. +30% damage for each marked enemy on the field.

name: Reconcile
description: Close the books: consume every mark on the field for +4 Tempo each.

name: Discrepancy
description: Chronal. Ignores armor and shields, hurts Echoes. Raises Entropy.

name: Full Disclosure
description: Capstone. Every enemy on the field is marked.
